description: Switch between Claude Code accounts in one click, with usage limits, analytics and notifications.
config.afterSwitch: What to do after switching accounts. Claude Code only uses the new account after the window reloads.
config.afterSwitch.ask: Ask whether to reload the window
config.showUsage: Show the usage limits (5-hour, weekly, per model) of each account.
config.usageRefreshMinutes: How often, in minutes, usage is refreshed.
config.refreshInactiveTokens: Renew the access token of accounts that are not active, so their usage stays up to date. The active account is always renewed by Claude Code itself.
config.warnAtPercent: Warn (and suggest another account) when the active account reaches this percentage of a limit. 0 disables it.
config.notifyWhenAvailable: Notify when a used-up limit of any account is available again.
config.statusBar: Show the active account in the status bar.
config.cliPath: Path of the 'claude' executable, used to add accounts. Empty = detect automatically.
